## [1.12.0](https://github.com/heval99/Heval-Morphe-Patches/compare/v1.11.0...v1.12.0) (2026-10-08)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **brave:** support Brave 1.96.61 ([5403b28](https://github.com/heval99/Heval-Morphe-Patches/commit/5403b28b0903429e93268622a545b635c5b346c9))
* support latest app versions, re-anchor YouCut, Bluecoins and BoxBox, remove Saphe Link ([1bc82ef](https://github.com/heval99/Heval-Morphe-Patches/commit/1bc82ef890513b742b0f5238535f2fcca256dd52))

### ✨ New Features

* **brave:** add experimental Disable telemetry, Disable ads and Hide promotional prompts patches ([e12fc36](https://github.com/heval99/Heval-Morphe-Patches/commit/e12fc369543df1a009ecdcc40b4147a7f05df15e))

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables AppLovin interstitial ads.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Disables AppsFlyer event logging, app-logged Firebase Analytics events and Crashlytics exception reporting.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium features by bypassing RevenueCat subscription checks.

patches.name: Brave Origin
patches.description: Unlocks Brave Origin and enables feature toggle controls.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Experimental: hides sponsored new tab images (including full-page takeovers) and the "Earn BAT for viewing ads" Rewards signup popup.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Experimental: turns off P3A analytics and the usage ping on every start (overriding the in-app switches), stops crash report uploads and drops the install-referrer attribution code.

patches.name: Hide promotional prompts
patches.description: Experimental: stops the recurring "Set Brave as default browser" dialog, the "Rate Brave" dialog and card, retention and Rewards promo notifications, the search widget promo and the VPN card in Settings.

patches.name: Enable Pro
patches.description: Unlocks YouCut Pro: watermark-free export and all paid features.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables the banner ad.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables Moon+ Reader's banner, interstitial, exit and native ads by forcing the central ad gate to always report ads as disabled.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables banner, interstitial, native, app-open and rewarded ads.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Fishing Points premium features and removes ads.

patches.name: Enable Pro
patches.description: Unlocks jetAudio Premium, all plugins and the ad unlocker.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Forces AdsRemovalSettings.areAdsDisabled() to return true, disabling banner, interstitial, MPU, hero placement, coverage sponsorship and announcement ads.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables banner, interstitial, native, app-open and rewarded ads.

patches.name: Enable FotMob+
patches.description: Enables app features locked behind the subscription paywall.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks the Monefy Pro features.

patches.name: Enable Premium+
patches.description: Enables app features locked behind the subscription paywall.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks the VIP interface and removes ads. Premium data the AiScore server delivers (e.g. predictions, dropping odds) is validated server-side and is not unlocked.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables banner, interstitial, native, app-open and rewarded ads.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables banner, interstitial, native, app-open and rewarded ads.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables banner, interstitial, native and rewarded ads.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Pi Music Player Premium (ad-free) by forcing the local purchase-state checks to true.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks the premium version (removes ads and lifts premium limits).

patches.name: Disable license check
patches.description: Skips the Play Store license check so the patched app starts.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Native Camera premium (RAW DNG, 10-bit/HLG/UHDR video, boosted modes and the higher bitrate cap). Premium is a local flag; the license check is disabled as well so the patched app starts.

patches.name: Enable Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Unified Remote Full by forcing the local license status check.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables banner, interstitial, native, app-open and rewarded ads and hides empty banner slots.

patches.name: Disable license check
patches.description: Skips the Play Store license check so the patched app starts.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) initialization, blocking banner, interstitial, rewarded, native and mediated ads.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics event logging and Crashlytics crash reporting.

patches.name: Block marketing notifications
patches.description: Blocks in-app promotional prompts, modals and promotion banners. Note: this only affects in-app promotions. Match-alert push delivery on re-signed builds needs working push delivery - use MicroG integration + signature spoofing where Play Services is absent (issue #25).

patches.name: Disable Facebook SDK
patches.description: Blocks Facebook Audience Network ads and disables Facebook event tracking while keeping Facebook Login working.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables banner, interstitial, feed, native, preroll and rewarded ads.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Disables AppsFlyer and Firebase Analytics event logging, plus Crashlytics crash reporting.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Marks the account as premium in the app. Note: AI insights and other premium content are served by Sofascore's servers for paying accounts and are not unlocked; use "Disable ads" for an ad-free app.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables banner, interstitial, native and rewarded ads.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Simple Radio Premium (ad-free listening) by forcing the local subscription checks to true.

patches.name: Enable Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Textra Pro: removes ads and unlocks the paid features.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Unlocks the ad-free purchase.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Stops the bundled Calldorado ad SDK: no in-app ads and no after-call ad screen.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks #Notepad premium and hides the paywall and in-app ad slots.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables banner, interstitial, native, app-open and rewarded ads.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Removes the 'notes_edit_banner' unit from utils/AdManager and the app-open ad from App$AppOpenAdManager. Both are gated on the single App.isAdFree() check, which normally depends on a VIP subscription.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks the VIP-only fonts, note backgrounds, stickers and drawing tools. The app checks entitlement entirely locally — there is no license server — so forcing the App.isVip() gate to return true unlocks everything, and stays unlocked even though BillingManager resets the underlying purchase flags from Play on every startup.

patches.name: Enable Pro
patches.description: Unlocks the FairEmail pro features.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables banner, interstitial, native, app-open and rewarded ads.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables banner, interstitial, native, app-open and rewarded ads.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks the 'Advanced device settings' features (Personalized Volume, Adaptive Audio, accessibility configs, hearing protection, etc.) that LibrePods gates behind the Play Store 'Unlock advanced features' one-time purchase. The patch forces the premium entitlement (PlayBillingProvider's _isPremium StateFlow) to always be true.

patches.name: Enable Full Version
patches.description: Bypasses the Play license check so the paid app runs as licensed.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks OsmAnd Pro, Maps+ and live updates.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Forces User.hasPremium() to return true, unlocking premium features locked behind the RevenueCat subscription entitlement.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables banner, interstitial, native/inline and app-open ads and hides the empty ad slots.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks the Pro/Premium features and lifts the free-version feature locks.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Switches the app to its built-in no-ads provider, removing banner, interstitial and video pre-roll ads (Yandex, Wortise and mediated networks).

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks the Pro-only access control settings (parental PIN, locking playlist/EPG/proxy/import-export/recording settings, hiding playlist URLs) and suppresses the in-app review prompt. Start on boot and autoplay last channel are only implemented in the separate IPTV Pro app and stay unavailable.
